intro
This is Teampot. Your pay, your team's budget and your perks, in one app, on Tempo.
home
Sam is a designer. His pay lands here, and his Design card was signed by Ava, his team's head. Tempo enforces its limit, and its vendors.
pay
He pays Figma with his card. It settles on Tempo in about a second, with a public record.
held
If a vendor isn't on the card, Tempo refuses the payment, and it goes to Ava instead.
approve
Ava approves it with her head key, and adds the vendor to everyone's card in one tap.
agent
Heads can give A I agents a card too, with their own limit and vendors.
finance
Jordan runs Finance. Every department is its own account. He funds it, and hands out the head keys.
payday
Payday pays the whole company in one payment.
send
Sam can send money to a teammate by username,
invest
put part of his pay into stocks,
visa
and tap his card at any shop. Same rules, checked against Tempo.
contractor
Contractors send an invoice, and get paid in seconds.
outro
Teampot. Finance sets the frame. Teams decide. Tempo enforces it.
